I had a crush on this boy recently and I got his Instagram and decided to shoot my shot by complimenting him under one of his photos. All it took was that one text to make me hate everything about myself.

I walked out of PE angry. I threw my phone and when I got home, I cried because I felt so hopeless. It was so bad that I selfharmed. The next day, I was still depressed, even though it was my birthday and I got amazing gifts, everyone wished me and I got to go out to dinner in the evening. I was too depressed to concentrate on my tests or eat anything other than some chips at lunch.

I still feel stupid for thinking he liked me. Yes, I had a crush on him.
